stories.title: datasette-agent-edit 0.1a0
stories.summary:
↳ WHAT'S NEW
datasette-agent-edit 0.1a0 is an early alpha plugin for Datasette Agent — Simon Willison's first in a planned series that lets AI agents make edits to existing text artifacts inside Datasette: Markdown documents, SQL queries, SVG files.

↳ THE REAL STORY
This is infrastructure, not a finished tool. The 0.1a0 tag signals Willison is laying the plugin architecture that future editing capabilities will build on. For developers already using Datasette Agent, this is the foundation that will eventually let an LLM rewrite a complex SQL query in-place or collaboratively edit a Markdown document without copy-pasting content out to a chat interface and back. The practical payoff is still ahead — but watching the plugin shape now tells you what the editing model will look like.
stories.considerations: The alpha label is doing real work here. 'Collaborative Markdown editing' and 'updating large SQL queries' sound straightforward until you consider conflict resolution, context window limits on large SQL, and how diffs get applied reliably. The open question is whether the plugin handles structured edits (patch-style) or just full rewrites — because for large SQL or SVG, full rewrites are expensive and error-prone, while patch-style edits require the model to produce reliable diff output. Worth tracking how that design decision lands in subsequent releases.
